workflow.name: Parity UI Journey Webhook
workflow.source: n8n workflow JSON imported through the UI import dialog

steps.name: import_n8n_json
steps.detail: Workflows -> Import -> file picker fed an n8n workflow JSON. The workflow 'Parity UI Journey Webhook (2 nodes)' was created and opened in the canvas editor.
steps.evidence: GET /api/v1/workflows/workflow_0f59d13d-f79a-43d6-b0ae-8b0ca03a5e0a returns 2 nodes (n8n-nodes-base.webhook v2, n8n-nodes-base.set v3) and connections Webhook.main[0] -> Set.

steps.name: canvas_editor
steps.detail: The React Flow canvas rendered both nodes (Webhook, Set) with the Webhook -> Set edge; the node palette (Triggers/Actions/Transform/Flow/Core/Data/Communication) was reachable.
steps.evidence: Screenshot of the canvas in the browser session; node headings 'Webhook' and 'Set' present in the accessibility tree.

steps.name: node_parameter_panel
steps.detail: Selecting the Set node opened the Parameters panel with the node type 'n8n-nodes-base.set', an 'Advanced: Raw Parameters' editor and the raw parameter JSON {'assignments':{'assignments':[{'name':'greeting','value':'={{ $json.name || "world" }}'}]}}.
steps.evidence: Panel textbox value contained the assignment array; node type label 'n8n-nodes-base.set' rendered.

steps.name: expression_validation
steps.detail: In the Webhook node parameter field an expression '={{ parity_ui_journey }}' was typed. The expression editor evaluated it live and reported a parse/identifier error with a highlighted source snippet, i.e. expression validation is live in the parameter panel.
steps.evidence: Error snippet rendered by web/src/components/workflow/parameters/ExpressionField.vue (evaluation error + highlighted span).

steps.name: expression_preview_row
steps.detail: The preview row below an expression field never renders. ExpressionField.vue computes the preview only when props.sampleInput !== undefined, and no caller supplies it: grep over web/src shows 'sampleInput' only inside ExpressionField.vue and expression/evaluator.ts, while ParameterField.vue renders <ExpressionField> without a sample-input binding. The Set node panel itself falls back to the raw-parameter editor, so there is no other surface that exposes a preview.
steps.missing_piece: web/src/components/workflow/parameters/ParameterField.vue must bind :sample-input to the node's input sample (last execution input) and expose a structured parameter editor for n8n-nodes-base.set. Both files live in web/, outside the scripts/parity + test-only-Go ownership of this task, so the wiring was not changed here.

steps.name: credentials_create
steps.detail: Credentials -> New credential -> Basic Auth -> created 'Parity UI Journey Basic Auth'. The credential appears in the credentials list.
steps.evidence: GET /api/v1/credentials lists cred_1794441340949561000_3 'Parity UI Journey Basic Auth' type httpBasicAuth.

steps.name: tags_create_and_attach
steps.detail: Tags panel -> New tag -> created 'parity-journey' and attached it to the workflow; the tag chip is shown in the editor toolbar.
steps.evidence: GET /api/v1/tags returns tag_1794441439584462600_4 'parity-journey'; the workflow payload carries tags:['tag_1794441439584462600_4'].

steps.name: version_history_create
steps.detail: Version history panel opened ('No versions yet'), 'Create new version' -> tag v1.0.0 + description 'Parity UI journey checkpoint version' -> Create. The version is listed as the current version.
steps.evidence: GET /api/v1/workflows/workflow_0f59d13d-f79a-43d6-b0ae-8b0ca03a5e0a/versions returns ver_1794441513553482800 versionTag v1.0.0 versionNum 1 isCurrent true changes ['Initial version'].

steps.name: run_workflow
steps.detail: Execute button on the canvas toolbar turned into 'Running...' and back to 'Execute'; the workflow was saved and executed manually.

steps.name: execution_detail
steps.detail: Executions page listed the new run; /executions/exec_1794441526209998100 rendered the Execution Detail view (Started/Finished/Duration 2ms/Mode manual), the node panes 'Webhook' and 'Set', the Input/Output tabs and 'Download as JSON'. The Output pane showed the Set node result.
steps.evidence: GET /api/v1/executions/exec_1794441526209998100 returns data [{'json':{'greeting':'world'}}] and nodeData for Webhook and Set.

findings.summary: Expression preview row is unreachable: ExpressionField.vue needs props.sampleInput, ParameterField.vue never passes it, and the Set node has no structured parameter editor (raw JSON only).
findings.owner: web UI (outside this task's file ownership)
